verdict_rationale: Cohort integrity independently verified from raw shards. All 137 failure entities, 141 episodes, and 200 normal entities are intact and 100% leakage-free. Window count differences between Phase 6.1 (1,212) and Phase 6.2 (5,727) are completely reconciled. Hybrid in-sample training audit confirmed zero holdout leakage. Evaluation denominators and alert semantics are fully operationalized.

difference_explanation.mechanism: 61 unused failing tasks in the raw trace had >= 5 valid bins before failure, but their failure occurred > 30 minutes after telemetry terminated. Under TargetLabelGenerator, all their windows had TTF > 1800s, generating 216 Normal windows and 0 pre-failure windows. Protocol 2.0 frozen entities include the 137 entities that generate pre-failure windows (996 windows).

grand_total_evaluable_windows.reconciliation_status: Mathematically reconciled. Protocol Clarification 2.1 clarifies that holdout evaluation evaluates 5,511 windows across the frozen 337 entities (335 evaluable).

hybrid_training_audit.tabular_vector: x_last in R^31 from Groups A-I
hybrid_training_audit.methodological_assessment: The Transformer backbone is trained on the training partition. Training-set fused embeddings are then extracted using this same backbone in-sample. Zero validation or holdout data enters the hybrid Random Forest. While holdout quarantine is strictly preserved, in-sample extraction creates a potential for the Random Forest to over-index on latent features that fit training noise.
hybrid_training_audit.recommendation_amendment_2_2: Protocol Amendment 2.2 Proposal: For future iterations, propose K-fold cross-fitting on the training split to produce out-of-fold embeddings for fitting the downstream Random Forest. For the current pre-registered protocol, maintain the frozen single-backbone design to adhere to pre-registered specifications.

evaluation_denominators.alert_rule: y_hat = argmax_c P(y=c | X). Alert triggered if y_hat in {1, 2}.

operational_gates.entity_far_gate: FAR_entity <= 12.0% (<= 23 false alarm entities out of 198)
operational_gates.window_fpr_gate: FPR_window <= 5.0% (<= 240 false positive windows out of 4,811)

evaluation_denominators.model_selection_policy: Models must pass BOTH gates to be eligible. Ranked by Episode Recall on the 141 episodes. Tie-breaker: Macro-F1. Fallback: NO OPERATIONAL WINNER if no model passes both gates.
